title: Unit Event — Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning

meta.Event: Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning
meta.Outline: While wondering what to do about the theme she was assigned during art class, Ena happens to come across Mafuyu sitting by herself on the side of a walkway. Ena decides to talk to her since it's raining and there's no sign of her moving...

rows.Line: Art class

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Hello, class.
Let's all do our best today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm getting kinda nervous...
What's he gonna have us do today?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (When he had us do still life drawings the other day, he gave me an earful about mine looking too flat.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I feel like I've improved since then, but...
 I still have a long road ahead of me.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I shouldn't let myself get down...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm gonna do what I can to draw something better today...!)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Alright, I will be announcing today's assignment.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Your theme will be “incubation”.
I'd like for you all to draw something that portrays this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Incubation...?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You will have six hours and then take a break after three hours. You may now begin.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Incubation... Incubation...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (When I hear that word, only eggs come to mind... But I can't just draw those. That'd be way too simple.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Time's up. I will now begin reviewing your work, so please bring your drawings forward.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
I managed to draw something, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Everyone else did such a good job...
I would've never thought of what they came up with.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Futaba's drawing in particular...
I really love her idea. A world inside of an egg, growing so big that it's breaking out of its shell...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Why do I have so much trouble coming up with creative ideas like that...?)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Alright, whose drawing do we have here...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
O-Oh, that's mine!
Please have a look...!

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Ah, Shinonome.
Okay, let's see...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Is this...a human that hatched from an egg...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yes...
I drew a person gazing at the vast world after just hatching.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: What were you trying to convey through your drawing, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
U-Uhh...
Having your breath taken away after seeing a completely new world, and getting excited by that prospect.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Ah, in that case, you might have wanted to use this person's gaze and expression a little more effectively to convey that better.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Is that sense of excitement and feeling of awe what you were truly after, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: From what I can tell, you simply drew whatever it was that came to your mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
No, um...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Well then, let's move on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
That should be everyone.
Good work today, all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What did I want to convey...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(He was right...
I just drew whatever popped into my head... None of my own feelings went into that drawing.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I thought I had improved a little bit, but...
I guess I really do have a long road ahead of me...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Hi, Ena.
Are you feeling okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah. I'm fine...
I mean, I'm pretty used to this now.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Today's assignment was pretty hard, wasn't it?
I struggle to come up with ideas from scratch, so I spent a lot of time thinking.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you too?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Yeah. Given the choice, I'd rather draw something that's sitting right in front of me.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Mr. Yukihira's always saying how I need to be more creative. Because of that, I always get really nervous when he asks us to do these sorts of assignments.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
He told me the same thing today...
But I managed to draw what I wanted, so I think I managed to make a little progress.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Progress...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(That's right, I almost forgot...
Futaba and the others in class take these assignments way more seriously than I do.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I need to start thinking like them.
I want to get better and catch up...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mr. Yukihira!

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, may I take this assignment home? I'd like to give this theme another try. I promise to bring something better next time!

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Understood.
I'll be looking forward to seeing what you have drawn.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Ena...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Today's committee meeting finished earlier than scheduled...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I could stop by somewhere to study... But I should probably go straight home. I wouldn't want Mom to worry.)
Asahina Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mom, I'm home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She's not in the living room...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't remember her saying that she'd be going out today...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But she could just be out shopping, so...
I should probably go up to my room to study.)
Mafuyu's Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Huh...? Wait, why...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Um...
Mom...? What are you doing...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, hello.
You're home early today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, my meeting finished earlier than expected, so I decided to come home to study...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, I'll need to prepare a delicious dinner for my hard-working daughter.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
O-Okay, thank you.
Um, also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What were you doing just now...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry for borrowing your computer without asking first. I was just looking something up...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Looking something up...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, but I found what I needed, so thank you for letting me borrow it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You were going to study, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Y-Yes...
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Incubation... Incubation...?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Is that sense of excitement and feeling of awe what you were truly after, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(What do I want to do for this theme...?
I need to figure that out.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Something being born...
Blooming... Growing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Wait, I want to grow as an artist...
What if I drew something that represented me trying to break out of my shell?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can try drawing myself hatching.)
se_event_wish_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, not bad...
I'll try going with this.
se_event_wish_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, my rough sketch is just about done...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's definitely not worse than what I drew the other day, and it goes with the theme...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can't pinpoint what it is... But it's like the person that I drew isn't actually me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I know I want to become an artist, and this is supposed to convey that and yet...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Is it the composition...?
Or maybe the perspective is messed up?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But the only thing that seems to stick out is “me”. The arms and legs don't look off-kilter or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do I just need to have more confidence in myself?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Knowing that my foundational skills are lacking and getting told that my drawings are bad... Am I starting to believe that there's no way I'll ever make it as an artist?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This isn't going to end up any better than before...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I should pick a different subject...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Have you all started working? The new demo's ready, so I'd like for us to meet in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What...?! Is it already time?
But I still haven't drawn anything I feel good about yet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess I should head over to SEKAI for now. A better idea might pop into my head while talking to the others.
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hi, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What's going on?
Did something happen again...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So... Mafuyu saw her Mom going through her computer.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! You set a password, right?! Don't tell me you didn't!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I did, but I told her what it was...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She said that I should if I had nothing to hide, and she never actually looked until now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But earlier today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I got home, I saw her using my computer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Why would she do that...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She told me that she was looking something up... But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why use your computer for that when she could just use her phone, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What if she was looking for what you've been up to, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember what happened to your synth? This might be connected to that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: After she learned that you were doing something that she wasn't aware of, she decided to secretly play detective...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A-And that led her to use your computer behind your back?! What's wrong with her...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, Mafuyu...?
Has she said anything to you since then?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No. I made sure to keep Nightcord and any song files hidden, so I doubt she found anything about all of you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But there's a chance that she'll come snooping around again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on. What if you just changed your password...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I did, she'd probably be suspicious.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why can't you just tell her to not look? She might be your mother, but she has no right to just rummage through your computer without your permission.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, that may be so...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I think she did it because she was worried about me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Being worried about you doesn't give her permission to do what she did.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, weren't you bothered by what happened? This is usually when you have to put your foot down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get that it's gonna be hard, but you really should say something if it's actually bothering you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Granted, that's a lot easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your song...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to hear your new demo...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on! We're not done discussing this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Okay, fine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll play it now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Okay, I get that it's hard for her to speak up.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I get that. But...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (From where I'm standing, despite trying to suppress her feelings, Mafuyu looks visibly shaken by what happened.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (So... Why didn't she say anything?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Doing as her parents say without bothering to speak up about what's on her mind... Isn't that just going to make her suffer even more...?)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've given it a lot of thought since then... But I'm still struggling to come up with a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Ideally, I want it to be something that involves me breaking out of my shell as an artist...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But this is getting me nowhere.
I guess I should go back to thinking about what I actually want to convey.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm? Over there...
Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...?
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I started feeling a little sick, so I decided to rest...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I think so...
I don't have a fever, and I felt fine during my cram school lecture.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No fever...
But you definitely feel sick, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm fine...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's just... My chest feels cold...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Rain...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh, this is the worst. The forecast didn't say anything about it raining today! You better head back home now too, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay...
After I rest for a bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, geez...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu, come with me!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're gonna get soaked!
How do you think I'm gonna feel if you end up catching a cold!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, we need to hurry!
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm back...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Ena.
Oh, who's this...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Um... Pardon the intrusion...
My name is Mafuyu Asahina. I'm a second-year at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I bumped into her just nearby and it suddenly started raining. I was hoping that we could give her some shelter for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh my...!
Ena, you have friends besides Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
Of course I have friends other than Airi.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I know. Anyway, Mafuyu, it isn't much, but welcome to our home. Please, come in.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I really hope Mafuyu's okay...)
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Mafuyu looked like she was in a lot of pain when she visited the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Len, are you worried about Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't help but feel concerned, even though she said she was fine...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, what her mom did seemed to really bother her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm worried too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. Unfortunately, me worrying probably isn't gonna help her feel better about what happened...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you think she's gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you're that concerned, why don't you go see her...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you don't necessarily have to do anything. You can be a source of comfort just by being there for someone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, Len, I think Mafuyu will feel a little better if you're with her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I'm not sure what I can do to help... But I'm gonna go over to see her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, that sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll leave Mafuyu to you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay...!
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Who would've thought that I'd end up bringing you here someday...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was hoping to work on my assignment after I got home too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Work on your assignment...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, for art class.
It's been giving me a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My plan was to get some good ideas together before working on N25 stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh... Then, I'll leave...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm keeping you from working, aren't I?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, but... You should stay!
I mean, what choice do I have? I'm the one that brought you here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, I have a feeling that you don't want to go home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, say something, will you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
Silent as always...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I assume she's thinking about her mom...)
<M-Mafuyu...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Len...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? What brings you here?
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<U-Uhh...
I was wondering if you were okay, Mafuyu, since you looked like you were in pain the last time we saw each other...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You look like you're feeling a little better...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, compared to last time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thank goodness...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's great and all...
But it's raining harder now, so I really think you should stay here a while longer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But what?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to go home...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?! Why?!
I thought you didn't want to go home!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not that I don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But this cold feeling comes over me when I think about it. And it hurts...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that because of what happened the other day...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... You really should just tell your mom how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Doing that is just going to make her worry even more...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Between missing that practice exam and breaking curfew, I've already caused her so much trouble...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I get what you're saying...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But are you happy with the situation?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to borrow your restroom...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <E-Ena...? Are you mad at her...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I'm not mad...
I just don't understand why she can't say what's on her mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Seeing the way she behaves...
It's like she's being silenced somehow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You're so strong, Ena...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <If I were her... I'd be too afraid to say how I really felt...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I mean, facing rejection from people you really care about, like your parents... That sounds awful...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Rejection, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think I kinda get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I drew because I wanted to become an artist, but he didn't understand and tore my dream to pieces...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I really didn't know what to do after hearing that.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I started to hate seeing him, and my room felt like the only place in the house where I belonged...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if Mafuyu's in a similar situation with her mom...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is Mafuyu afraid of being rejected by her? Is that why Mafuyu does as she's told...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm back...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, Mafuyu...!
Welcome back.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's my mom...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hello? Mom?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um, I'm studying at a friend's house right now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, we have a quiz coming up.
I'm sorry for not letting you know sooner...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, for the love of... Quit pandering to her.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(How are you okay with this?!
On top of being forced to study all the time and give up the things you like doing, she looked through your computer without permission!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If this keeps up, you're never gonna break free from her grasp...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Which means the real you is going to...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What? When am I coming home...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Gimme that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Pardon me. It's nice to meet you. My name is Ena Shinonome. I'm the friend Mafuyu was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Shinonome? Yes, it's nice to meet you. So... Are you Mafuyu's classmate?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I go to a different high school.
We were studying together and lost track of the time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Ah, I see.
Thank you for being friends with Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <By the way...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <How did you two meet exactly?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <If you don't mind me asking...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Mafuyu mentioned a friend who plays music. Is that you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Have you not told her about us making music?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No...
Because I think all she wants me to do is study.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She even tried to get rid of the synthesizer in my room once already...

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ena
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, Mafuyu...?
Has she said anything to you since then?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No. I made sure to keep Nightcord and any song files hidden, so I doubt she found anything about all of you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Based on what she said, her mom doesn't know about N25...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I have to think that she's still trying to look for answers.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Music...?
No, I'm not sure what you're talking about...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Is that so? I was hoping to thank that person for teaching Mafuyu so much about music. But...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <That wasn't you, it seems.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I doubt she was talking about me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <I see. I apologize for jumping to conclusions.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <So... What are you to my daughter?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll handle this. You stay quiet.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I met Mafuyu through art.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Art? Can you elaborate...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I really don't like bringing his name up, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, Mafuyu and I met when she came to see one of my father's art exhibits. We got to know each other after that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Art exhibit...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, have you heard of Shinei Shinonome? He's my father...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Wait, Shinonome...? Didn't he just do an exhibit at the Shibuya Art Museum?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, that's him! I ran into Mafuyu while helping out at one of his other exhibits...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: After finding out that she liked his art and that we were the same age, we really got along!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Yes, I see.
I had no idea that Mafuyu was friends with the daughter of such a great artist...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I always enjoy hanging out with her. And much like how she was helping me study today, she's done a lot for me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
There's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Ask me? How can I help?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I had Mafuyu be a model for one of my drawings?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Model for your drawing...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes. I'm not directly following in my father's footsteps, but I'm also trying my hand at art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And she fits exactly what I need to do for my current assignment. So, I'd like to have her be my model...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's wonderful.
Mafuyu would feel so honored to have the daughter of such a great artist to draw her.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
However, I need to finish my drawing tonight, so I was wondering if Mafuyu could stay over at my house.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Tonight? My, that's very sudden...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Mafuyu's very busy preparing for entrance exams right now, so I'd rather have her spend her nights studying...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <But spending a day at a friend's house may end up being a nice refresher...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Ms. Shinonome, I'll leave her in your hands.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Now, would it be alright if I spoke to Mafuyu?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Of course...
Mafuyu, your mom wants to talk to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry about this all of a sudden, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, of course... I'll make sure to not cause any trouble. I'll also make sure to study as much as I can tonight.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, okay... Thanks, Mom.
I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Good night...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was exhausting...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There. Now you don't have to go home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But why a model?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, that was the first thing that popped into my head...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I don't actually plan on making you model for me, so you can relax.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, this probably means I won't have any time to work on my assignment.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess I should try to come up with some ideas if I find the time.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I need to tell my mom about what's happening since she's gonna need to make more for dinner now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'll go with you...
I should thank her now that I'm staying over.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You sure? You don't have to, but...
Alright, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, you can wear these pajamas. They should be pretty clean since I hardly ever use them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Ena! Dinner's ready!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Be right there!
Let's go, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, I'm starving...
Mom, what did you make for dinner...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Akito, welcome home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's with the attitude? I was just welcoming you home. And why are your eyes going all over the place? What's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, that thing you're carrying... Isn't that from the new pancake shop that just opened up by the station...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... Why you of all people?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on! You bought some for me too, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why would I do that?
You honestly expect me to buy something for you every time I go to one of these places?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me? You're not the only person in this house with a sweet tooth, so you could show a little more courtesy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, on second thought, that means you would've had to buy some for Mafuyu too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Pardon me.
Um... You're Akito, yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, hello...
Sorry, we didn't mean for you to see that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I apologize for the sudden intrusion. Some things happened today that led to me staying over for the night.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
We don't have much to offer here, but please make yourself at home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Geez, enough with the faces, you two...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Alright, all of you, come sit down before dinner gets cold!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Be right there.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That includes you, Mafuyu. Please, join us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But, you're too kind. You've already agreed to let me stay over for the night and to also be given dinner on top of that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You really don't have to feel so apologetic, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, we're having Salisbury steaks today? Nice! They look delicious!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hang on... Mom!
How many times do I have to tell you?! No glazed carrots!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Stop complaining and eat what's on your plate.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Also, Mafuyu, Ena's right.
Please feel free to make yourself comfortable.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: More importantly, I hope what I've made is to your liking.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, everything looks delicious.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, want these glazed carrots?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pushing the things you don't like onto Asahina would just bother her, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In my hands, they'll go to waste. So, isn't it better to give them to someone who enjoys eating them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm saying that you should quit complaining and just eat them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's okay for you to refuse, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Says you, Mr. Picky...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Or do you want them instead?
In that case, here, they're all yours!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey! Stop it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: All I'm saying is that you should stop complaining and just eat them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I was talking about stuff that's on your own plate.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
That's enough, you two.
Your Salisbury steaks are getting cold!

rows.Speaker: Akito & Ena
rows.Line: Yes, Mom...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Please don't hesitate and eat as much as you'd like, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you.
And this Salisbury steak's very good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Even though you don't know what anything tastes like? You really don't have to put on your honor student act in front of her...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's been a while since we last had these.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: When I heard that Ena was having a friend over, I couldn't help myself and decided to put together a little feast.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Again, thank you for letting me stay on such short notice. I also really like Salisbury steaks, so I'm glad you made them for us.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm happy to hear that.
By the way, you go to a different school, yes? How did you two meet?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're both in the same music group making songs together, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but keep that to yourself. Mafuyu's mom doesn't exactly approve.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
I think it's wonderful that you make your own music.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's just... I have to study and...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Ah, because entrance exams are coming up. In that case, I somewhat understand your mother's concern.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Still, it's important to stop and smell the roses, you know? Or would your mother not like me saying that...?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: In my case, I'm worried about Ena since she's doing what she loves but always seems so frustrated.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Guh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She's worried...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I suppose that's only natural...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: But what I say won't change who my children are. Which is why I believe it's important for her to live her life the way she likes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(The way she likes...?
But...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
If there's something you truly wish to do, I plan on being there to support you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm worried about you, so I can't help but state how I feel... However, Mafuyu, it's ultimately your life to live...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So you're free to do whatever you like...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She seems so different from Mom...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm always gonna do whatever I like regardless of what anyone says.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, yes, I know.
But don't forget to study a little too along the way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you could learn a lot from Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh! Shut up!
Also, Akito, you're one to talk since you usually just barely get by on your test.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, as long as I'm not failing.
Don't forget that I study with my teammates before tests and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Well, I'd actually rather have you aim for at least an average score, though.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Guh...
M-Maybe when practice ends early for a change...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I knew it...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This house feels so different...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (At my house, we usually have very settled discussions during dinner and hardly ever argue...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (However, despite all this arguing, Ena's house doesn't feel cold or distant at all...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I apologize for us getting into such a heated discussion, Mafuyu. Especially after inviting you into our home...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...
I also discuss my studies with my parents on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
You do? That's wonderful.
If possible, would you mind tutoring these two from time to time?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Ena, Akito, please let me know if you ever need any help with studying.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll pass. Mafuyu tutoring me sounds like torture.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm sure she'd feel the same way about being your tutor.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me?! I'm not you! I can get good grades if I try!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's this, Akito? You haven't touched the carrots that you like so much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, I'll give you some more since I've got plenty left on my plate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I said quit it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What is this...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My chest feels so...light...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This house looks no different from mine, but something about it is.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What is that difference exactly...?)
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whew, I'm stuffed...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you shoved all of your carrots onto my plate...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Don't forget that we have a guest, you two. Try to keep it down.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Again, Mafuyu, I'm very sorry about how heated things got between these two.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it felt like a lively discussion since I'm an only child.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you don't have anyone to argue with as an only child. Why couldn't I have been one too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's my line.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I'm not sure if we had the cleaners do the guest bedding. I think it's still sitting in the closet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
It's been forever since Airi last came over. The pillow's probably completely squished.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's okay, really.
You don't have to mind me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You must have nerves of steel if you don't care about sleeping on a flat pillow. That'd bother me way too much.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
She's just being polite.
But I appreciate your modesty, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Also, the bath should be ready soon, so why don't you go first? In the meantime, we'll get your bed ready.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...
But is it really okay for me to...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't worry about us.
I mean, you're one of the very few friends Ena has.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, it's best to go before Ena since it's always impossible to tell when she's going to be done.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I don't take that long!
Quit giving her all these wrong ideas about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, I'll go first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait! The shampoo in the front's mine, so don't use it. The one in the back is Mom's so, use hers!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why can't you just let her use yours...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because it's really expensive!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, the one in the back. Got it.
I'll be right out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, why's she friends with you...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: FYI, I'm usually the one taking care of her!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? There's no way that's true.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... Akito's saying all this stuff without understanding what Mafuyu's actually like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To be fair, he probably wouldn't believe me if I told him about what's behind her honor student persona...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <H-Hello...? Ena?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Len, hi. Sorry, I didn't realize you were still here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mafuyu's taking a bath right now.
She should be out soon.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Okay...
So, how's Mafuyu doing...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Hmm... I'm having a hard time telling as usual... So, no different from normal?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay... That's good to hear.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyway...
I need to come up with some ideas for my assignment before Mafuyu gets back...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What assignment...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
For art class.
It's been giving me a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Can I see what you've drawn, Ena...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<No, wait. I'm sorry...
You need to work right now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm drawing a blank right now, so I don't mind if it's just for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Also, it's really nothing special...
Oh, what if I showed you what I've drawn in my sketchbook?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's see... Here's a sketch of a flower vase. This one's of a wolf that I saw when I was little. And here's some stuff that I drew for N25.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wow, so many drawings...!
You're a really good artist, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? I'm nothing special, really...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I'd love to see more...
Do you have any other drawings?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is of one of my friends who's an idol now. She's really nice, super cute and has such a cheerful personality.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I have drawings of Kanade and the others too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's Miku..!
She has such a gentle-looking smile on her face.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thank you for showing me these, Ena. They're all really good, but I think I liked the ones of everybody the most...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Len, want me to draw you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Huh? M-Me...? I dunno...
I think I'll get really jittery if you do...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, what about Mafuyu...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah. She's really calm and collected, so she'd be easier to draw compared to me, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess she wouldn't get nervous or jittery.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But Mafuyu? As a model...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena, I've finished taking my bath.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: ...? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, drawing you could be good practice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu, let me do a sketch of you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me? Why...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, I asked her to.
It's just... I want to see what Ena's drawing of you would look like.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Of me...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. That is, unless you don't want to...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright. Then, we'll get started after I take my bath.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

Ena's Room

rows.Line:
<Wow, that's so cool...
You really are drawing her.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena, what sort of expression do you need me to make...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your usual one should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honestly, I wasn't expecting to actually do a drawing of her...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She's so expressionless... It's like I'm drawing a sculpture.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You really are a good artist, Ena...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <And it's so admirable how you're still trying to get better...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not good or anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I do want to get better.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: To be fair, each day feels like a struggle since no matter how much I draw, I keep getting told how awful my drawings are.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But this is what I want to do.
This is the path I've chosen.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I don't care what anyone says.
I'm not gonna stop drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know me doing this makes my mom really worried sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I honestly think that doing art is what suits me best.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What suits you best...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. So, why don't you try telling your mom what you really want to do?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Including the part about your synth...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I already told her that I don't want to stop...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I told her that I know that I need to study but also want to keep making music...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you did?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She already tried...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And she said that I'm free to do as I wish...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Then...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But she also told me to not regret my decision...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She was telling me to think about my future and not make regretful choices...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? What's she talking about...?
Why would you regret making music?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't think that's what she was talking about...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Knowing her, she was probably more focused on my future...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: By becoming a doctor, I'll be able to help many people and live comfortably...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, you're not wrong. But...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My mom knows that things will become much harder if I don't study and do well on the entrance exams...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I said that I'd step away from music...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! You actually told her that?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And you're really okay with that...?
None of this bothers you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I study and bide my time, by the time I'm in university... I might be able to pick it back up...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, for now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And yet, you're still here making music with us...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's what I still don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The other day, Ena, when you said, “You wouldn't be in SEKAI if you thought your mom was right.”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I agree with you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It made me wonder why am I doing the opposite of what my mom is telling me to do...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because that's what you wanted to do, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You want to make music and go to SEKAI. It doesn't matter what she says. You're not willing to give those things up. You want to be a part of N25. Am I wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's only natural for you to feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It is...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just look at me. I draw because I want to draw, and I believe I'll be rewarded in the future.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, I would think that there's a part of you that knows what would truly make you happy. And it's not what your mom decides...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What makes me happy...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Mafuyu...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This is a tough one...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I get that her mom means a lot to her... But why can't Mafuyu just say what she wants to do.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, based on our conversation, it's clear that her heart lies elsewhere.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hmm... What if it were me in her shoes? Would things have turned out differently...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If my parents constantly pushed their ideals onto me because it's “for my sake”...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Would I have turned into Mafuyu...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's take your mom out of the equation for a second, Mafuyu. What do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I want to make music with all of you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, as a fellow member of N25, I'll do what I can to help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At the same time, “being yourself” is probably easier said than done in your case.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, why don't you use today to practice doing just that? It'll be your chance to do whatever you want...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, it's already 25:00?!
I need to get to work! I totally lost track of the time while drawing...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Work...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: On N25 stuff! Don't you also have work to do?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Am I allowed to...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? You're kidding, right?
Kanade's probably done polishing up her song, which means Mizuki and I need you to finish writing your lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, lemme open up Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, what's Yuki doing at your place, Enanan?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, so...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I took a rest while on my way home and it began to rain. Enanan saw me and had me come over to her house...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But my mom called to tell me that I needed to come home...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, Enanan asked her to let me stay over for the night.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <E-Enanan, you really did that?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What choice did I have?
I couldn't just leave her given the state she was in.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <A-And what Ena did was so cool.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Cool?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <When Mafuyu was being told to come home, Ena took the phone from her and started speaking to Mafuyu's mom directly...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, really...?
Way to go, Enanan!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't do anything special, but I couldn't just sit idly.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, Yuki!
What's Enanan's house like?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, that's none of your business!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Enanan's house...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Her room's a mess.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! It's clean enough!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Clean...?
But you have clothes and art supplies strewn everywhere.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha! I can totally see that!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <However, her room's probably a lot cleaner than mine...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
You really do need to do some cleaning, K.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Y-You're right...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, what else?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Her house seems a little different from mine, but I'm not sure how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I bet it is.
At the very least, it's probably more lively.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I have this image in my head of Enanan's mom being just as animated as her daughter.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, totally!
Oh, did you get to see Li'l Bro?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, they began fighting after Enanan made him eat her carrots...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, they don't need to know that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! You two never change!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't blame me! He's the picky one! And he's so obnoxious about it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I can already see it!
Man, I wish I could've been there with you guys.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way, Amia. You're just gonna make things worse.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we get to work...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. Okay!
I've probably asked enough questions already♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, about the demo I had you all listen to before... I'll send it over now that I've had a chance to work more on it. Please let me know what you think of it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, K.
I'll listen to it now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This sound...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, are you writing right now? You already have ideas for some lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I had a general idea of what to do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, what do you have in mind?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What do I have in mind...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't really know how to explain it...
So, I'm going to try writing it out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm, okay...
Lemme see after you're done writing them since it's probably gonna determine what I sketch.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Sure, but...
What do you plan on drawing, Enanan?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... The intro feels kinda heavy, so I was thinking of something along the lines of trying, believing and running towards the light at the end of this song.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For the chorus, I had this sort of picture in mind.
se_event_wish_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't tell what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Gimme a break! I only spent a few seconds sketching it! Look, it's a person looking up above!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I can sort of make out the light...
But it feels more like they're being freed as opposed to rising towards it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Being freed...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I get the sense that their legs feel very heavy at first and slowly become lighter as time progresses.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, what happens after they're freed?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But...
Once they are free, I think they'll be able to walk on their own two feet.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: On their own two feet, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, what if I had something like a vine wrapped around them...? Like this.
se_event_wish_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A vine...?
It looks more like a string.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Again, it's just a rough sketch!
I'll clean it up later, so for now, try to see past that!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You two seem to be having more fun than usual...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's like you're really getting to know each other better! Maybe it's because you're having a sleepover?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? This is how we normally interact.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I felt the same thing...
Mafuyu, you seem to be having more fun than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <And I think it's because of Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm really not doing anything...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She's having fun...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, she's really focused on writing now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Yeah, she does seem to be enjoying what she's doing. It's hard to believe that her mom was all that was on her mind a second ago...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is fairly preliminary, but I have lyrics for everything up to the first post-chorus. Mind taking a look...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Send what you have over.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, I wasn't expecting this!
I like it! I think I'll try listening to the song again♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm starting to get what you mean by “being freed”.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, with that in mind, I'll try redrawing my sketch...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll keep writing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you both very much. Please keep up the good work.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wow, she seems even more focused now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And she's doing her best to put what she feels onto paper after listening to Kanade's song.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She said that she told her mom about making music, but it must've taken a ton of courage to say that she doesn't want to quit...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I think I just realized how much making songs means to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How much it means to me...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't say for certain, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right now, I want to keep doing this with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, that expression... Did you just...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What's going on, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nothing. Or rather...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on. Where did I put my sketchbook...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It should be near your bag...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you going to use it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, um... You just sit there and keep working.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(That expression...
It was nothing like her usual stoneface.)
se_event_wish_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I think I just got a glimpse of her true will...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's like she's doing exactly what she wants to do.)
se_event_wish_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I had no idea she could make this kind of expression. I was under the impression that everything was dull and gray to her...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She did just say, “I want to keep doing this with all of you.” Does that have anything to do with what I'm seeing now...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No one told her to do this.
She's doing this out of her own free will...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, done...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, you've already finished your sketch?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I just finished drawing Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, have a look.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh wow...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You have such a cool look on your face, Mafuyu...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you think, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is this how I look to you, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It seems a bit...strange...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, why...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why exactly do you see me this way?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How...?
I think it's because I caught a glimpse of your true will just now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My true will? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Or rather... Your desire to do what you're doing now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, there's no way for me to actually know if I'm right! This is just an interpretation of what I saw!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get back to work!
The next morning
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Zzz... Zzz...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, it's morning already...
No wonder I feel so sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
I'll open the curtains.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, don't...!
It'll be too bright!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The light will help you wake up.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hm...? Is it morning already...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
See? You woke Len up.
He was sleeping like a baby too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Morning, Len!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Mhm... Morning...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, today's been a lot of fun for some reason, and I got a ton of work done too!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Same...
It was nice to see you really enjoying yourself, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, you haven't been able to log on much lately because you've been so busy.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which made hanging out with you until the morning like this really nice!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I haven't been able to work like this in so long...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I were at home, I probably wouldn't have been able to. So... Enanan, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, um... You're welcome.
I mean, it was nice to get away for a bit, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, I've reached a good place to stop, so I'm gonna go to bed.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Me too. I'll put on the finishing touches after a quick nap.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay.
Night, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Kanade
rows.Line:
<Night!>
<Good night.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I think I'll get to work on my assignment.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your assignment...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, for art class.
I've got a good idea of what I wanna draw now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: All thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Me...?
But I didn't do anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You don't have to understand.
But thanks anyways.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Good luck, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Then, I'm going home.
I have cram school starting around noon, so I need to head back and get my things.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Shouldn't you sleep for a bit first?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm fine now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Alright, I think I'll head back too...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Good luck to you both, Ena, Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you, Len...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Good night.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Len also seems to be feeling a lot better now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And he really liked my portrait of you... Oh, I know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, as a small token of my appreciation and since it turned out so well, you can have it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll see you later on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, time to get to work...
se_event_wish_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what to do when I heard that our theme was “incubation” since I'd never tried to draw something based on that before.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I think I know what to do now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. So, why don't you try telling your mom what you really want to do?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Including the part about your synth...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I already told her that I don't want to stop...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I told her that I know that I need to study but also want to keep making music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My mom knows that things will become much harder if I don't study and do well on the entrance exams...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I think I just realized how much making songs means to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How much it means to me...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't say for certain, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right now, I want to keep doing this with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I know you can't do much right now since you're still stuck inside your shell...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (One day... I want you to break out of it with your own power.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to see you driven by your own free will to see the wide world that's out there.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And live your life the way you like, Mafuyu.
A few days later
Art class

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
I see.
So this is what came to mind when you heard “incubation”?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, what do you think of it...?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: First, your brushwork for the background leaves a lot to be desired. I can see that you were trying to depict daybreak, but I'm seeing blotches of colors here and there.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: As for your figure, their joints don't seem fully connected, which gives them an unbalanced appearance. They seem so stiff that it's hard to tell what sort of pose they're trying to do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: But you've done a good job with the irises. I can see from there that they yearn to break free from their shell and soar into the sky.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: And how the artist wishes to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (He got it...! I didn't say anything, but he got my message...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Shinonome, I cannot give you a pass since you failed to finish it in the time allotted. Nonetheless, well done.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I hope you'll work to fix your mistakes and look forward to doing better next time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I will...!
Thank you very much, Mr. Yukihira!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
I managed to accomplish my main goal...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She probably doesn't realize it, but I also ended up learning a few things from Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Still, I'm way behind the others.
I need to keep practicing for next time.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Someday, I'm gonna get really good, and draw something that properly illustrates the music Kanade and Mafuyu make.)
